title: Brush, Brush, Brush! 🪥 Sing Along with Max the Cat
description:
Sing along with Max the curious cat and his friends! 🐱🎶
Five happy songs for kids about everyday life: brushing teeth, eating yummy veggies, playing in the park, building a sandcastle at the beach and a cozy goodnight lullaby.

0:00 Brush, Brush, Brush! 🪥
2:13 Yummy Veggies! 🥕
4:21 Let's Play in the Park! ⚽
6:25 Sandcastle Song! 🏖️
8:43 Goodnight, Max! 🌙

Sing along with Max again tomorrow! 🎵
